<thought>Analyzing the isotopic series, the intensities follow a binomial distribution consistent with many carbon atoms (≈18 C) where the 13C natural abundance (≈1.1%) produces successive peaks decreasing by ~0.11 each additional 13C. No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
